title: WaterColor 27 WaterColor Blvd W #102
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 6 amenity access bands.**- Located in the heart of WaterColor's TownCenter- Screened porch- Washer/Dryer- Remodeled Bathrooms 2024- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Now featuring brand new updates to the kitchen! This beautiful 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condominium is located at 27 WaterColor Boulevard with accommodations for 6. Walk directly from the front porch of this condo to the heart of the TownCenter, and you'll be at the beach in seconds! Take a stroll to a Friday afternoon wine tasting, enjoy lunch or pool time at the WaterColor Beach Club. Ride your bike to Seaside or through the many WaterColor trails or spend your day on the beach - it's one of the best locations in the community! This unit features a great floor plan with a combined kitchen and living room that is all open and very easy to enjoy cooking and entertaining with friends. The kitchen has been upgraded to include fabulous stainless steel appliances, a gas cooktop, and custom cabinetry. There is combined seating for 9 at the breakfast bar and dining table to enjoy a meal. There is plenty of room to gather in the living space around the flat-screen TV, with a sunny view of the neighborhood from the French doors overlooking the porch. The primary bedroom suite has a king bed and private balcony access, as well as a bathroom with a walk-in shower, separate tub, and large walk-in closet. The second bedroom has a queen bed with newly remodeled shower bathroom that is shared with the hallway. There is also a full-size sleeper to accommodate extra guests. Enjoy the peaceful vibes that WaterColor has to offer from the screened front porch and or side porch. This unit also comes with 2 adult bikes to make getting around 30A even easier. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower- Living Room: Full Sleeper WATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preserves*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
